???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What do we call instructions in the numeric form a processor can execute directly?"

        Machine code. A file of it that the operating system can start is an executable.

        Introduced in [Overview](index.md).

    ??? question "What do we call a program that reads source code, checks it, and writes out code a machine can run?"

        A compiler. It also rejects programs that break the rules and explains the problem.

        Introduced in [Overview](index.md).

    ??? question "Which tree keeps only the meaningful parts of a program and drops punctuation whose job the tree's shape already shows?"

        The abstract syntax tree (AST), which the guide simply calls the syntax tree.

        Introduced in [3. The parser and the syntax tree](stage-3-parser-and-tree.md). Specification: [12. Glossary](../../specification/glossary.md).

    ??? question "Which written record does a test compare against to decide whether it passed?"

        The expected output, such as the program's printed text or the error's kind and location.

        Introduced in [0. The workbench](stage-0-workbench.md).
